verdict.rationale: Aider's docs show it installs and runs on the user's own machine (pip/curl installer) against the local git repo. Its own documented local-model support (Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible local API) lets the whole stack run on user infrastructure without a vendor-hosted service. missing for 10: explicit open-source/license or source-availability evidence, documented fully offline/air-gapped deployment guidance, independent hands-on corroboration of self-hosted local-model use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Aider can work also with local models, for example using Ollama. It can also access local models that provide an Open AI compatible API.
